levels.surface: محمد بن أحمد بن علي الهمداني

notes: the epithet «بياع الزطي» is left out (rule 1 stops at the name)
«وكان خالد» is left out: the parallel al-Kafi reads «وَ كَانَ خَالَهُ» (his maternal uncle), so it is not a link here; if a reader takes it as a name, it needs a ruling
the Imam after «سمعت» is the last link (ruling 2)
